payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: 0091's design (134ab2a) is read and approved, with one amendment. Write it in before the code. macos.bats also calls isolate_tool_homes at the top of its setup(). It runs no git today, but a suite that overrides setup() and skips the isolation is the gap itself, and one call costs nothing. The red stays as you measured it: a signing GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL turns menuz.bats's source_home red through the recording gpg, and green after the call. Runs: menuz.bats and macos.bats whole on both bashes, light, booked. It lands after cc's 0084, which changes test_helper.bash, re-applied on that head. utilz-dc's 0088 adds a guard over every suite that defines teardown(), and vc asks dc whether the same guard should also cover setup() and isolate_tool_homes. If dc takes that, your two calls are what make it pass.
